user.title: Safety Hub
user.description: Configure the Safety Hub hazard monitoring system

data.auto_config: Automatically configure hazards, sensors and devices

update_settings.name: Update settings
update_settings.description: Updates configuration settings for Safety Hub.

category.name: Category
category.description: Hazard category (e.g. water, fire, gas, temperature, power, global).

value.name: Value
value.description: New value for the specified setting key.

toggle_service_mode.name: Toggle service mode
toggle_service_mode.description: Toggles global service mode on or off to suppress alerts during maintenance.

test_alert.name: Test alert
test_alert.description: Triggers a simulated hazard alert for testing notification and action channels.

category.name: Category
category.description: Hazard category to test (water, fire, gas, temperature, power).

execute_actions.name: Execute actions
execute_actions.description: Whether to execute automated physical actions (e.g. valves/switches) during the test.

dismiss_alert.name: Dismiss alert
dismiss_alert.description: Dismisses active alerts for a specified hazard category and cancels reminder loops.

category.name: Category
category.description: Hazard category to dismiss (water, fire, gas, temperature, power).
